Day by day
01
Sat 19 Dec PERTH

Fly to Perth

Overnight flight HKG → Perth (~8 hrs, no time-zone drama). Pick up the hire car, check into the CBD apartment, and walk down to Elizabeth Quay as the lights come on.

HKG ✈ PERHire car · 7 days
02
Sun 20 Dec PERTH

Kings Park + Fremantle

Kings Park lookout over the Swan River in the cool of the morning, then Fremantle's Christmas markets and fish & chips on the harbour at sunset.

Kings ParkFremantle sunset
03
BEACH DAY
Mon 21 Dec ROTTNEST

Rottnest Island

Thirty-minute ferry, hire bikes, and the quokka selfie everyone came for. Snorkel at The Basin, then the late ferry home. Book the ferry now.

Ferry 30 minSnorkel The Basin
04
Tue 22 Dec MARGARET RIVER

Drive South

Perth → Margaret River (~3 h 15 m) via the Busselton Jetty — walk or ride the little train to the end. Settle into the pool house for four nights.

Drive 270 kmBusselton Jetty
05
BEACH DAY
Wed 23 Dec MARGARET RIVER

Surf, Caves + Chocolate

Beginner surf lesson for the kids in the morning, Mammoth Cave after lunch, then the chocolate and cheese factories on the way home.

Surf lessonMammoth Cave
06
CHRISTMAS
Thu 24 Dec MARGARET RIVER

Christmas Eve

Wade with the stingrays at Hamelin Bay, climb Cape Leeuwin lighthouse where two oceans meet, then the Boranup karri forest. Pre-buy tomorrow's food — most shops close.

Hamelin Bay raysCape Leeuwin
07
CHRISTMAS
Fri 25 Dec MARGARET RIVER

Christmas Day

A Christmas morning swim at the beach, presents by the pool, BBQ lunch at the villa (pre-booked), and sunset on the sand.

Beach swimVilla BBQ
08
Sat 26 Dec DEPARTURE

Fly Home

Drive back north (~2 h 15 m from Busselton), return the car at the airport, and fly home to Hong Kong. One car, one drive down, one drive back.

Beach, quokkas and caves are easy wins for a 6-year-old — no cold, no ski gear, no queues. A house with a pool instead of hotel rooms, and Christmas Day spent entirely outdoors. Most shops close on the 25th, so the villa BBQ is the plan.
